note: The pictures the built player's proof (-gameProof) takes that the HUD budget judges in the batch and that Glyph reviews at 2x (the 2160 set: the same proof at -capture-size 3840x2160). A set names its section of proof.json `frames`, the C# file that takes the pictures and each picture (<name>.png with <name>.hud.png, <name>.manifest.json and <name>.parts.json beside it). tools/game/proofset.test.ts holds every name to the C# source, so a renamed picture is a failing test, not a picture quietly dropped from the budget. `optional`: a picture only some runs take. `crop`: HUD parts that stand on every frame (the roster, its portraits, the scope, the keys, the history) and so are left out of the 2x crops, but that this picture is of: they are cropped here. Add a section's pictures here when its proof lands; `bun tools/game/proofset.ts` says what it does with them. r123 (batch 0.2.123 host round 4, Latch; Proof123.cs) is in the budget and the 2x crops from 2026-10-26 but NOT gated: its section is not in tools/game/proofgates.ts GATED until Glyph agrees its density (briefs/067/splice.md item 5, Aster's note).
